_: SRD 5.2.1 SHOULD spells, cantrips and level 1 (docs/v1_spell_list.md), CC-BY-4.0. Ranges are in squares: one square is five feet. A spell marked 'approximated' never ships under its SRD name.

effects.note: SRD 5.2.1: a flame in your hand for 10 minutes (v1: the fight): bright light 20 feet and dim light 20 feet beyond
until it ends, a Magic action hurls fire at a creature within 60 feet: a ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire, a die more at 5, 11 and 17
SRD 5.2.1: on a hit, the target's speed is 10 feet less until the start of your next turn

SRD 5.2.1: for 1 minute (the fight) a club or quarterstaff you hold may use your spellcasting ability for attack and damage, rolls a d8 (d10 at 5, d12 at 11, 2d6 at 17), and may deal force damage - v1 takes whichever of each is better for you
SRD 5.2.1: on a hit, the target can't make opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn
SRD 5.2.1: a creature within 15 feet at 0 HP and not dead becomes Stable; the range doubles at 5, 11 and 17
minor wonders - a booming voice, flickering flames, tremors, a slammed door, altered eyes - for up to 1 minute. narrative by nature: authored interactables and dialogue answer it

SRD 5.2.1: one attack with the weapon used in the casting, using your spellcasting ability for attack and damage, dealing radiant or the weapon's type (v1 takes the better); +1d6 radiant on a hit at 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17

SRD 5.2.1: a ranged spell attack for 3d8 of the type you choose; if two of the d8s match it leaps to another creature within 30 feet of the target, with a new attack and damage roll, once per slot level, never to the same creature twice

SRD 5.2.1: a Wis save or the creature follows the word on its next turn. Approach: toward you by the shortest route, ending its turn within 5 feet. Drop: drops what it holds and ends its turn (picked up again for free next turn if it is still there). Flee: its turn is a Dash away from you. Grovel: Prone, and its turn ends. Halt: no move, no action, no bonus action. One more creature per slot level above 1

SRD 5.2.1: a bonus action right after you hit with a melee weapon or unarmed strike: 2d8 radiant more from that hit, +1d8 against a Fiend or Undead, +1d8 per slot level above 1. a critical doubles the dice

SRD 5.2.1: a 20-foot cube; outlined creatures shed dim light (narrated - v1 has no light levels in a fight), attack rolls against them have advantage, and they can't benefit from the Invisible condition

SRD 5.2.1: a reaction when you or a creature within 60 ft falls - up to five falling creatures descend 60 ft per round for 1 minute and take no falling damage. v1 has no falling and no 'falls' trigger, so it is cast as an action and the campaign's authored falls answer it
SRD 5.2.1: a 20-foot-radius sphere of heavily obscuring fog for up to an hour, 20 feet wider per slot level above 1. a strong wind is the narrator's
SRD 5.2.1: ten berries for 24 hours (until the next long rest); a creature eats one as a bonus action to regain 1 HP, and one is a day's food
SRD 5.2.1: a reaction to taking damage from a creature within 60 ft; that creature makes a Dex save

SRD 5.2.1: Wis save or Prone and Incapacitated for the duration, unable to stand; it saves again at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage (with advantage then), and a success ends the spell
the touched object's magical properties, attunement, charges and the spells affecting it. information by nature: the campaign supplies what is learned
SRD 5.2.1: a bonus action right after a melee hit: 1d6 fire more from that hit
and at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute (the fight) it takes 1d6 fire and then makes a Con save, a success ending the spell. all the damage grows by 1d6 per slot level above 1
a soundless image up to a 15-foot cube, movable as a Magic action, seen through with an Investigation check. authored interactables answer it; there is no illusion sandbox, as with Minor Illusion
10 minutes of speech with Beasts. dialogue by nature: authored animal conversations answer it

v1_spell_list.md's Dissonant Whispers is not in SRD 5.2.1, so it ships as an original spell under an original name (decisions_checklist.md section 1, 2026-09-24): 3d6 psychic, Wis save for half; a creature that fails spends its reaction running as far as its speed allows away from you
